entry.title: Open Space Committee: the meeting of 9 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Open Space Committee reelected its chair and began rewriting land-acquisition criteria, to return in October. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qp-NjUCVwuc), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
